Answer: C
Reason: The sequential chest X-rays demonstrate the rapid onset of severe, bilateral diffuse alveolar opacities (Figure 1 and 3) followed by near-complete resolution within a few days (Figure 4a), a clinical course characteristic of Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome (ARDS) responding to mechanical ventilation and supportive care. Pneumonia typically resolves more slowly, and cardiogenic edema usually presents with cardiomegaly which is not prominent here.
